items.item: A lifecycle rule's inputs are strictly age, tags, prefix and size — on all three clouds, none of them can see a table format's own metadata

at.step: What is the rule blind to?

items.item: The hook's corruption is categorical, not a tuning mistake: no cutoff value for the lifecycle rule can fix it, because the rule has no way to ask whether anything still references a file

at.step: What is the rule blind to?

items.item: Ordering, not a smarter rule, is the only fix: expire the snapshot before any age-based delete is allowed to run, every time, on every schedule
